text:
Platinum Price in 2019
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2019, the LBMA platinum price rose 16.0% between 2019-01-31 ($821) and 2019-12-30 ($952). The highest sampled price was $952 in December and the lowest was $791 in May. The mean of these observations was $878. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
